calibration: Finite Fourier intrinsic/DM nuisance; additive independent Gaussian white scales bounded simultaneously with 0.0005 failure probability; 60 common Fourier harmonics, gamma=13/3, max equivalent strain 6e-15 each for HD, monopole and dipole. Fixed geometry contrasts with chi-square union bound. Valid conditional on this noise model.
upper95_amplitude: Simultaneous one-sided upper bound on the Euclidean norm of the response amplitude on the eligible grid, conditional on the fixed waveform and Gaussian noise model. Worst eligible-grid bounds by family/shape accompany injection completeness.
recovery: 256 off-grid injections per family/shape into observed NG narrowband residuals, uniform eligible 30-day grid epochs with offsets -12,-6,0,6,12 d and isotropic directions/polarizations; nearest-cell family-wise crossing with aligned amplitude and all leave-one-out tests passing. Recompute variance bounds after each injection. Completeness is conditional on this residual realization and precedes external characterization.
